Arigenn is allowed to do that since he's dealing with Ask the Seniors questions in this case. Just like Map Developers are allowed to post map acceptances/denials on map threads (creating a small flood of map threads), the Seniors are allowed to do this as well, as long as its for a beneficial reason.
